_finding: Owner, 25.11 (docs/list-locks-tz.md v3, the 35 to 50 minute delay for new listings accepted): a record on the issuer list is called listed only when the chain backs it, the pinned Base prefix and the issuer factory having created it, confirmed by a second RPC where there is one. Anything else gets no verdict on every route; a held original is never offered instead of a look-alike. One source of listed records feeds every route, the archive fixes when an address was first listed, and the production entry point runs with the locks on.
